01 / SUMMARY

About

I am a Senior AI Research Engineer at MKD, an AI startup in Busan, South Korea. My work spans model development, data pipelines, retrieval, agentic systems, and private enterprise AI.

I gather client requirements, build demos, and coordinate research, backend, and frontend colleagues through production delivery. I also help secure cloud and GPU resources and mentor internship students every semester.

Alongside industry work, I am a PhD candidate in AI Convergence Engineering at Pukyong National University. My academic background includes healthcare AI, IoT, lab coordination, and teaching assistance.
